materiality_logic: Emergency-preparedness floors are governed by the 16 planning standards, EPZ assumptions, protective actions, KI limits, medical/population monitoring, ingestion controls, exercises, coordination and recovery proof, not every nuclear assurance gate.
KI is a supplemental thyroid-blocking countermeasure for radioactive iodine when directed; it never closes evacuation/shelter/decontamination/monitoring/recovery gates.
Plume-pathway proof needs alerting, evacuation/shelter, KI decision, route/demographic data, special populations, worker safety and exercises.
Ingestion-pathway proof needs food/water/agriculture controls, sampling/chain-of-custody, lab QA, public dashboards and recovery decisions.

For eligible new-technology facilities, use performance objectives, drills/exercises, hazard analysis, EPZ basis, public information, communications, reentry, ingestion response and corrective actions; do not treat performance-based EP as exemption.
Recovery proof includes controlled reentry, relocation support, cleanup/waste, food/water controls, population monitoring, claims, benefits continuity and counterevidence closure.
